answer: Anchor every agent to one verified-human credential tied to a unique trust-graph vertex, then demand a locked stake that scales with claimed voting weight and slash it on double-signing. A Sybil farmer must buy a fresh credential and post a fresh bond for each fake identity, and one caught fraud burns the whole set. Like a narrow inlet feeding a vast ocean, the cost of flooding the network rises with every extra drop, so mass imitation never pays.
